title: Cross-team signal scan - mini brief
summary: One-page ad-hoc tracker to triage short-lived signals touching multiple teams (serving, infra, SRE, product). Purpose: capture quick facts, owners, and immediate next-actions for a 2-week rapid sweep. Lightweight, meant to be pasted into Slack and iterated in meetings.
rows: SIG-001 | serving-runtime | Diego Morales | P0 | partial | increased tail latency on 2048 seq on p4x | trace sample: reqs 14:23-15:02, qps spike 2.3x | assign triage + kernel-sampling (serving-runtime) | 2029-09-18
SIG-002 | observability | Samantha Lee | P1 | none | missing token-level cost for new embed-route | console dashboards show nulls since 9/12 | add lightweight metric shim + alert | 2029-09-20

SIG-003 | private-deployments | Ravi Patel | P2 | partial | VPC customers report intermittent auth 403s | customer repro attached (acct-554) | reproduce in staging + rollback recent KMS change | 2029-09-21

SIG-004 | platform-engineering | Aisha Khatri | P1 | degraded | autoscaler misfired for dedicated-pool-eu | autoscale logs show missed heartbeat between 02:00-02:10 | manual scale + postmortem runbook update | 2029-09-19
action_items: Diego: run kernel sampling and paste diff to thread by EOD 9/18
Samantha: deploy metric-shim to staging and verify dataflow by 9/20
Ravi: gather customer repro and validate KMS key rotation plan by 9/21
Aisha: temporary autoscale guardrails + notify on-call until PM fix (9/19)
notes_to_self: Keep this sheet intentionally compact. If a signal evolves beyond two CI cycles, move to a dedicated incident doc and link back. Avoid over-instrumenting; this is a fast sweep tool.
meeting_use: Use as meeting starter: paste top 3 rows into daily 10:15 standup Slack thread, callouts only for P0/P1. Use row comments for status changes.
